versions.changelog:
Initial release — Eight-dimension WeChat article growth analyzer for "爆款" diagnosis and optimization.

- Supports analysis of WeChat articles via URL or full text, with detailed eight-dimension scoring (title, open, value density, emotion, structure, triggers, interaction, visuals)
- Provides "爆款潜力" comprehensive score (0–100), cause analysis (why hot/not), strengths extraction, and granular improvement suggestions for each dimension
- Delivers content growth strategies: content matrix, topic direction, title templates, publishing rhythm, and growth levers
- Adapted for article, video, and data input; includes scenario descriptions for different user needs
- Professional, actionable reporting format with transparent boundaries, example-based guidance, and field-adaptive diagnosis
